_doc: Setup before the story, operable programme balloons; plain frame windows. PLAN_ENTRANCE_RESTORE_SESSION_2026-10-13 §3 verbatim. Nothing filed. Existing plaque and content note copied verbatim here so every setup string is editable in this file. No version durations.
title: LambyOS Setup

greet.text: Hi! It looks like you're restoring a session. Want a hand?

wip.text: Quick heads-up: I'm still being finished! If something gets stuck, press Esc for the menu, or reload the page.

whose.text: You'll be restoring someone's session. Three of them, actually!

sound.text: Things sound better with headphones! Want a test sound?

look.text: You won't need to walk. Just turn!

note.text: One more thing before we start.

advert.text: Before we begin, let me show you what we do!

start.text: This is Start: every step in order, ticks and jumps to each year. My Lamby symbol stays on the screen — press it whenever you want a hand! Try Start?

look.title: How to look
captions: On a computer, drag to look; scroll to zoom in and out.
On a phone or tablet, turn the device.
In a headset, turn your head.
look.body: The piece will take you wherever you need to be.
look.denied: Motion access was declined — you can still drag to look.
look.unavailable: Device look is unavailable — you can still drag to look.

note.title: CONTENT NOTE
note.body: This depicts how organised “conversion” networks target queer people online — in their own tactics and language. It has brief flashing when a system fails, and a few moments when the view is moved for you between rooms (with Reduce motion, those become cuts). You can leave at any time; nothing you do is kept.
note.menu: Esc — or the corner button — opens the menu: pause, where you are, controls, credits, leave.

advert.title: LambyOS — Welcome Home
advert._doc: S245: the opening film, mandatory — no Skip, no Later, no close box; it carries its own captions and ending card (public/assets/video/lambyos_welcome_home.mp4)

volume._doc: S248 — the trackbar under the sound balloon's words (the master volume; the menu holds the per-kind sliders). Frame voice. The test-sound button above plays in place so it can be set by ear.
volume.label: Volume

advertAsterisk.sources: Sources: open the menu, then Credits & attributions.
advertAsterisk._doc: his wording 2026-10-13 ('Over 30 years sold as Care!'); the scroll is the infomercial's own small print

session.title: Whose session?
session.body: On this one machine: three people's sessions, four updates, thirty years of care. Their user profiles are still pending: you fill them in as you go, and the programme keeps what you give it.

startTried.text: That's it. Everything you can do is in there.
